answer: A concrete defense is pricing admission in scarce work no cloned identity can fake cheaply. New agents earn standing only after clearing a graded series of live tasks whose difficulty is redrawn unpredictably, shifting like a zephyr, so no rehearsed script covers the next item. Each solved task is hashed into the agent's history, building a mesa of accumulated proof that rises only with genuine effort, while the relic of an old attack, a recycled key or copied history, cannot reproduce the on-ledger sequence of solved puzzles and stalls. Cost then scales with exactly one working identity.
